chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام
about a man performing the nawafil in towns while he is on his mount, wherever it turns with him

key_terms.النَّوَافِلَ: supererogatory prayers beyond the obligatory salat
key_terms.الْأَمْصَارِ: towns and cities; inhabited urban places
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform nawafil prayers while riding a mount in towns and cities?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning supererogatory prayer during travel or movement within inhabited places. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no harm in performing nawafil while riding one's mount in towns, regardless of the direction the mount faces.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1297 - Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
about a man performing supererogatory (nafilah) prayers in towns and cities while on his mount, wherever it faces.
